title: Marginal Calibration Does Not Compose: Hidden Dependence in Modular Robot Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2609.23731v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic systems are typically composed of multiple independently developed modules that work together to perceive, predict, and act in the environment. Although each module may perform reliably in isolation, composing them does not necessarily preserve uncertainty calibration at the system level. In this work, we show that well-calibrated component interfaces do not necessarily produce calibrated downstream behavior after composition. Using a moving-obstacle prediction pipeline, we demonstrate that position and velocity estimators can each appear well calibrated individually, yet differences in how their error are correlated lead to substantially different estimates of future-state uncertainty. Consequently, assuming independence can make the system either overly confident or unnecessarily conservative, directly influencing downstream planning decisions and safety. translated_title: 边缘校准不可组合：模块化机器人导航中的隐藏依赖性
translated_abstract: 机器人系统通常由多个独立开发的模块组成，这些模块协同工作以感知环境、进行预测并采取行动。尽管每个模块在单独运行时可能表现可靠，但将它们组合起来并不一定能在系统层面保持不确定性校准。在这项工作中，我们表明，经过良好校准的组件接口在组合之后并不一定能产生经过校准的下游行为。通过一个移动障碍物预测流水线，我们证明了位置估计器和速度估计器各自单独来看校准良好，但它们误差之间相关方式的差异会导致对未来状态不确定性的估计大相径庭。因此，假设各模块相互独立可能使系统要么过度自信，要么不必要地保守，从而直接影响下游的规划决策与安全性。通过仿真实验，我们表明对联合协方差进行建模可以恢复……
tldr: 该论文揭示了模块化机器人系统中各模块单独的边缘校准无法保证组合后的系统级校准——模块间误差的隐藏相关性被忽略会使系统过度自信或过度保守，而建模联合协方差可以恢复系统校准。
en_tdlr: Marginal calibration of individual modules does not compose into system-level calibration in modular robot navigation, because hidden error dependencies between modules can make the composed system overconfident or unnecessarily conservative, and modeling the joint covariance restores calibration.
